title: Use MongoDB for the ledger prototype
author: dana
body:
Bootstrapping the ledger service.

Decision: Store ledger entries in MongoDB.
Why: The ledger schema is still changing every week and a document store lets us iterate without migrations.
Affects: ledger_service, ledger_service/store.py

comments.author: sam
comments.body: Fine for the prototype. We should revisit once we need multi-document consistency.

title: Customers double-charged during ledger write failures
author: sam
body:
Between 14:02 and 14:40 UTC, 312 customers were charged twice.

Root cause: Debit and credit ledger entries were written as two separate MongoDB documents without a transaction. When the second write failed, the retry re-issued the charge.
Affects: ledger_service, payments_api

title: Migrate the ledger from MongoDB to PostgreSQL
author: priya
body:
Follow-up to INC-7.

Decision: Use PostgreSQL (payments-db) for the ledger and all payment records.
Why: Debits and credits must be committed atomically in one ACID transaction; MongoDB documents were written independently and caused double charges.
Supersedes: MR-12
Caused by: INC-7
Affects: ledger_service, payments_api, payments-db, ledger_service/store.py

comments.author: sam
comments.body: Rule: Ledger debit and credit entries must always be written in a single database transaction.

title: Revoked tokens accepted for up to 10 minutes
author: lee
body:
A contractor's access was revoked but their token kept working for 9 minutes.

Root cause: verify_token() results were cached in Redis with a 10 minute TTL, so revoked credentials were still treated as valid until the cache entry expired.
Affects: authentication_service, auth_service/verify.py

title: Remove caching from token verification (security fix)
author: lee
body:
Security fix for INC-11.

Rule: Authentication responses must never be cached.
Why: Cached responses stay valid after credentials are revoked, which let a revoked token keep working.
Caused by: INC-11
Affects: authentication_service, auth_service/verify.py

comments.author: priya
comments.body: Approved. If latency becomes a problem, scale the auth service horizontally instead of caching.

title: fix(auth): drop redis cache from verify_token (MR-42)
author: lee
body: Removes the 10 minute Redis TTL cache. Refs MR-42, INC-11.

comments.author: sam
comments.body:
This uses float for the refund total, which rounds 0.1 + 0.2 wrong.

Rule: Money amounts must be stored as integer cents, never as floats.
Why: Floating point rounding produced refunds that were off by one cent in testing.
Affects: payments_api, payments_api/refunds.py

title: Should we switch the public API to GraphQL?
author: alex
body: Just a thought: maybe GraphQL would make the mobile client simpler? Not proposing anything yet, curious what people think.

comments.author: sam
comments.body: Interesting, but no appetite for this right now.

title: Idempotent payment webhooks
author: priya
body:
Stripe retries webhooks, and we processed some twice.

Decision: Payment webhooks must be idempotent, keyed by the provider event id stored in payments-db.
Why: Providers retry deliveries, and duplicate processing re-applied payment state changes.
Affects: webhooks_service, payments-db, webhooks_service/handler.py

title: feat(webhooks): store provider event ids for dedupe (MR-70)
author: priya
